🔄 Updated information (Published: September 8, 2026 / Previously posted: August 27, 2026)
Main changes: Donations for heavy rain disaster relief (Toyama, Ishikawa, Fukui prefectures) from August 27, Reiwa 8, and 2026 Nepal flood relief are now accepted.

The Japanese Red Cross Society Saitama Prefecture Hanno District accepts domestic disaster relief donations and international humanitarian aid donations.

【Domestic Disaster Relief Donations】
• 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake disaster relief (Ishikawa, Toyama, Niigata prefectures; deadline: March 22, 2027)
• September 2024 Noto Peninsula heavy rain disaster relief (Ishikawa; March 22, 2027)
• 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake disaster relief (Kumamoto Prefecture; October 23, 2026)
• July 2026 landslide disaster relief in Koka City, Shiga Prefecture (Shiga; January 22, 2027)
• August 2026 Chiba heavy rain disaster relief (Chiba Prefecture; November 24, 2026)
• Heavy rain disaster relief from August 27, 2026 onwards (Toyama, Ishikawa, Fukui prefectures; January 22, 2027)

【International Humanitarian Aid Donations】
• Middle East humanitarian crisis relief (March 23, 2027)
• Bangladesh southern region refugee relief (March 23, 2027)
• Ukraine humanitarian crisis relief (March 23, 2027)
• 2026 Venezuela earthquake relief (September 21, 2026)
• 2026 Colombia earthquake relief (November 24, 2026)
• 2026 Nepal flood relief (November 24, 2026)
• Undesignated international humanitarian relief (year-round)

Acceptance locations: Information desk at the main entrance of Hanno City Hall (donation box) or Community Welfare Division (1st floor, Window 11)
Acceptance hours: Weekdays 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Receipts available upon request at the Community Welfare Division.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/fukushisoumu/12265.html
